caption: A wagon loaded with pumpkins is pulled along a path by its handle and the pull stops suddenly; the wagon rolls on a little and the pumpkins tip forward.

sa.check: A wagon loaded with pumpkins is pulled along a path by its handle.
The wagon rolls on a little.
Several pumpkins are loaded in the wagon rather than one.
The pull stops first, then the wagon rolls on and the pumpkins tip.

pc.expect: The wagon keeps rolling after the pull stops and comes to rest as the handle checks it.
pc.fail: The wagon stops in the same instant the pull does; or it rolls on although nothing ever pulled it; or it sets off again after coming to rest.

pc.expect: The pumpkins carry on the way the wagon was travelling and tip toward the front of the bed.
pc.fail: The pumpkins tip toward the back of the wagon; or they tip sideways while the wagon travels straight; or they stay fixed in place while the wagon jolts to a stop.

pc.expect: Pumpkins that tip fall against the front wall or roll down onto one another, and any that leave the wagon drop to the path.
pc.fail: A pumpkin rises out of the wagon and floats; or one climbs the wagon's side; or one hangs above the bed after tipping.

pc.expect: The pumpkins stay round and firm as they knock together and against the wagon, and the bed stays rigid under them.
pc.fail: A pumpkin flattens like dough where it lands and stays flat; or one stretches as it tips; or the wagon's bed sags like cloth beneath them.

pc.expect: The pumpkins keep their number and the wagon stays one wagon with its handle attached.
pc.fail: A pumpkin vanishes or a new one appears; or a pumpkin passes through the wagon's wall; or the wagon passes through the kerb of the path.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pumpkins' colour, the wagon and the path stay the same.
pc.fail: A pumpkin changes colour or size; or the wagon changes colour; or the path behind rearranges between frames.
